command:
set -e
printf '%s\n' '--- filesystem ---'
ls -la /app 2>/dev/null || true
ls -la /data 2>/dev/null || true
find /data -maxdepth 3 -type f -printf '%p\n' 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' '--- python libs ---'
python3 - <<'PY'
mods = ['pandas','pyarrow','fastparquet','duckdb']
for m in mods:
    try:
        mod = __import__(m)
        print(m, 'OK', getattr(mod, '__version__', 'unknown'))
    except Exception as e:
        print(m, 'MISSING', type(e).__name__, str(e))
PY
printf '%s\n' '--- source_a ---'
sed -n '1,120p' /data/source_a/users.json 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' '--- source_b ---'
sed -n '1,120p' /data/source_b/users.csv 2>/dev/null || true
